overview-description: MEED+ ranks climate mitigation actions for your city based on the emissions in this inventory, your socioeconomic context, regulations and strategic priorities. Switch inventories to rank actions against a different year's emissions data.
wizard-intro-description: Walk through seven short steps — from reviewing this inventory's emissions to setting your strategic preferences — and MEED+ will generate a ranked list of the highest-impact mitigation actions for your city.
inventory-not-found: This inventory could not be loaded. Please pick another inventory or go back to your city page.
